headline: Half-price rail travel extended to 18-year-olds
summary: From 17 August, eligible teenagers can buy the 16-17 Saver for a full year after purchase, keeping its 50% discount on most train fares into adulthood.
script: Eighteen-year-olds in Britain will soon qualify for a full year of half-price rail travel through the 16-17 Saver. From 17 August, eligible teenagers can buy it until the day before turning 18, extending the benefit into their first year as adults.
